body: May useful evidence shortcut sa CAA warning: kapag ang supposed recovery path mismo ay humihingi ng bagong investment, fee, o payment bago raw maibalik ang old loss, iyon ang claim na dapat i-verify independently—not the testimonials or emotional story around it. Hindi ibig sabihin na lahat ng paid recovery help ay fraud; ang point is mas mataas ang burden of proof kapag ang proposed cure recreates the same money-transfer vulnerability that caused the first loss.
